title: In Someone Else's Hand
victim: L, the detective leading the Kira case
teaser: The Kira investigation headquarters. In the evening L told the task force he'd name Kira in the morning, and put the building into night lockdown. At 02:40 he was found in the monitor room: his heart had stopped, his face was calm. Next to a half-eaten cake lay a scrap of notebook paper with his real name printed on it in capitals. And the corridor camera showed nobody passing in all that time. Someone wants this to look like Kira's work.

habits.label: Munches apples
habits.habit: Munches one apple after another, right down to the stalk
clues: An apple core that hasn't browned yet lies under the desk in the monitor room. The culprit munches apples.
An apple stalk with a bit of flesh on it lies on the lift floor. The culprit munches apples.

habits.label: Eats crisps
habits.habit: Eats crisps straight from the bag, even while working
clues: Potato crisp crumbs are stuck between the console keys, and L didn't eat crisps. The culprit eats crisps.
At 02:30 the corridor microphone recorded the rustle of a crisp packet. The culprit eats crisps.

habits.label: Heart stickers
clues: There's a pink heart sticker on L's monitor that wasn't there in the evening. The culprit sticks heart stickers everywhere.
The button of the lift to the monitor floor has a heart sticker on it. The culprit sticks heart stickers everywhere.

habits.label: Eats chocolate
habits.habit: Always has a bar of chocolate and bites straight off it
clues: The bin by the airlock has a dark chocolate wrapper torn open with teeth. The culprit eats chocolate.
The armrest of L's chair has a brown fingerprint: it's chocolate. The culprit eats chocolate.

habits.label: Twirls a strand of hair
habits.habit: Twirls a strand of hair round a finger when thinking
clues: Hairs twisted into tight ringlets are caught on the back of L's chair. The culprit twirls a strand of hair round their finger.
An evening recording made before the switch shows someone at the monitor room door twirling a strand of hair round a finger. The culprit twirls a strand of hair round their finger.

habits.label: Handheld console
habits.habit: Plays on a handheld console even in meetings
clues: The guard at the airlock heard quiet beeping from the dark corridor, like a handheld game console. The culprit plays on a handheld console.
An AA battery, the kind handheld consoles take, lies under the console desk. The culprit plays on a handheld console.

habits.label: Beeping watch
habits.habit: Wears a wristwatch that beeps every hour
clues: At exactly 02:00 a short wristwatch beep came from behind the monitor room door. The culprit has a watch that beeps every hour.
A pin from a watch strap lies on the floor by L's chair. The culprit has a watch that beeps every hour.

habits.label: Smells of hairspray
habits.habit: Sets their hair with hairspray, and the smell lasts all day
clues: The lift that went up to the monitor room has a sharp smell of hairspray. The culprit smells of hairspray.
The scrap of notebook paper is slightly sticky and smells of hairspray. The culprit smells of hairspray.

habits.label: Bright lipstick
clues: The rim of a cup by the console has a scarlet lipstick print, and L drank from a different one. The culprit wears bright lipstick.
In the basket under the desk there's a crumpled napkin with a scarlet lipstick mark. The culprit wears bright lipstick.

habits.label: Two phones
habits.habit: Carries two mobile phones and never gives anyone the second number
clues: At 02:35 a phone rang in the server room with a ringtone nobody on the team has. The culprit carries two phones.
A SIM card snapped in half lies in the bin by the lift. The culprit carries two phones.

habits.label: Green tea from a flask
habits.habit: Only drinks green tea from their own flask
clues: There's a wet ring from a flask by the console and a few green tea leaves. The culprit drinks green tea from a flask.
In the night green tea leaves were shaken out into the HQ kitchen sink, though the whole team drinks coffee. The culprit drinks green tea from a flask.

habits.label: Wears slippers
habits.habit: Pads around HQ in soft house slippers
clues: An investigator on the residential floor woke at about 02:30 to the shuffle of slippers outside the door. The culprit walks around HQ in slippers.
A tuft of pink plush, like from a slipper, is left on the carpet by L's chair. The culprit walks around HQ in slippers.

habits.label: Chews pen caps
habits.habit: Chews a pen cap when thinking
clues: A chewed pen cap lies under L's chair. The culprit chews pen caps.
A pen with a bitten cap was left on the console, and L never chewed pens. The culprit chews pen caps.

habits.label: Leather jacket
habits.habit: Never takes off a studded leather jacket
clues: The monitor room door frame has a fresh scratch from a metal stud. The culprit wears a studded leather jacket.
The corridor microphone recorded a creak of leather, as if someone walked past in a leather jacket. The culprit wears a studded leather jacket.

habits.label: Learns English from flashcards
habits.habit: Learns English words from flashcards and keeps them in their pocket
clues: A vocabulary flashcard lies under L's chair: "justice: seigi". The culprit learns English from flashcards.
A card reading "verdict: hanketsu" was found on the floor of the entrance airlock. The culprit learns English from flashcards.

habits.label: Film camera
habits.habit: Goes around with a film camera round their neck
clues: The guard saw a camera flash in the monitor room window at 02:20. The culprit carries a film camera.
The wastepaper basket by the console has an empty film canister box in it. The culprit carries a film camera.

strong: A strawberry from the cake is squashed on the floor by the chair: L fell, yet he was found sitting at the console. Someone lifted him and sat him back down, as if he'd died at work. The culprit is physically strong.
During lockdown the door between floors can only be opened by hand with a heavy lever, and tonight it was opened. The culprit is physically strong.
quiet: The guard walks the floor every half hour and listens at each door. At 02:30 he passed the server room and heard nothing, though someone was inside. The culprit moves silently.
An investigator was dozing on the sofa by the monitor room entrance and swears nobody went past. The culprit moves silently.
tools: The microphone under L's desk didn't go silent by itself: one thin wire in it was snipped and neatly wrapped back together. The culprit is good with small electronics.
A fishing line is tied to the inside door handle, its end run out under the door. That's how the room was latched from outside. The culprit is good with small electronics.
medic: L's teapot held traces of a drug that stops the heart just like an ordinary attack. The culprit knows medicine.
L drank his tea at about one in the morning, and his heart stopped at 02:15. Whoever added the drug knew exactly how long they'd have to wait. The culprit knows medicine.
keys: The monitor room opens with an access card. The door log shows L's own card, though it was in his pocket all evening. The culprit had access to the cards.
The cabinet of spare access cards in the airlock was opened with a card of its own, not forced, and one card is missing. The culprit had access to the cards.
safe: L's computer is password-protected, but at 02:31 it was opened on the first try and one folder was deleted. The culprit knows the HQ passwords.
The building lockdown was lifted for twenty seconds, and the log shows the correct code. The culprit knows the HQ passwords.
sched: The guard at the airlock was called to the phone at exactly the hour his wife always rings. The call was fake. The culprit knows the HQ routine.
At night L sends everyone to bed at half past one and stays alone, and only the team knew that. The culprit knows the HQ routine.
tech: For forty minutes the corridor camera showed footage of the empty corridor recorded the night before. Someone swapped the signal. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
At 02:10 a message went out from L's laptop over the HQ network in his name: "Do not disturb until morning." The culprit knows their way around machinery.
cash: In the evening, before lockdown, the cake courier was let into the building without a search, and the guard was paid for it. The culprit has money and connections.
During the day a sponsor sent new monitors to HQ, and one box had a false bottom. That's how things the guards mustn't see get carried in. The culprit has money and connections.
passages: A service corridor that isn't on the floor plan leads from the underground car park into the building, and tonight it was used. The culprit knows the back ways in.
On the helipad the hatch into the lift shaft is open, and someone climbed down the rungs in the shaft to the monitor floor. The culprit knows the back ways in.
